name: Tubal
overview: Tubal is a male figure identified in Scripture as a son of Japheth. Beyond this genealogical note, there is no additional information or tribal affiliation provided about him. His mention serves primarily to trace the lineage of the descendants of Noah through Japheth.
namesAndTitles: The name Tubal appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:2, with no specific meaning or divine origin indicated. It is simply recorded as the name of this individual without further elaboration.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Tubal as a son of Japheth, situating him within the post-Flood genealogical framework. No other familial relationships or descendants are noted in the biblical text provided.
scriptureSignificance: Tubal's significance lies in his inclusion among the descendants of Japheth, contributing to the biblical account of the nations' origins after the Flood. His mention helps establish the spread of humanity and the fulfillment of God's command to populate the earth. While details about his life are sparse, his place in the genealogy underscores the faithfulness of Scripture in preserving the lineage from Noah's sons.
